items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Lizzie Miles; the mention is made solely by the interviewer.

ctx.x: And it is continued at Caleret and called it Poggle. And that's around 1936 somewhere around. They changed that then.

Somewhere around that time. I know Lizzie Miles used to tell people she was born on Bourbon Street like between Burgundy and Dolphin or something. Right. People wouldn't believe her. They'd say, well, that doesn't cross those streets, it goes the same direction. Right. They wouldn't believe her. They wouldn't believe it. That's right. They'd say that they changed the name. Uh-huh. And it turns down. Now let's see, any other drummers on parade, I started to ask, did you ever remember Ernest Trepanier?
Yeah, yeah, exactly, yeah. He was supposed to be a good bass drummer, they tell me.
